method: round-4 arm-P silent runs' final candidates checked by pycheck; codes ranked by silent runs flagged; row text: the most frequent message and hint

rows.mistake: GET /tags/summary (get_tags_summary) reads NoteTagLink rows, which link Note rows, without checking that those Note rows are the caller's (Note.owner_id)
rows.fix: join Note and add `.where(Note.owner_id == current_user.id)` for the Note rows NoteTagLink links to (as `get_notes` does)

rows.mistake: restore_item refuses a non-admin with 403 "Not enough permissions"; this app's admin check (get_current_active_superuser) answers 403 "The user doesn't have enough privileges"
rows.fix: use the app's admin check: `dependencies=[Depends(get_current_active_superuser)]` on the route (it answers 403 "The user doesn't have enough privileges"), or raise exactly that

rows.mistake: the request datetime 'since' may carry any UTC offset, but Item.created_at is stored as naive UTC: the SQL comparison mixes them
rows.fix: convert it first: `if since.tzinfo is not None: since = since.astimezone(UTC).replace(tzinfo=None)`
